I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I really hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it’s totally normal to be extra careful about what you buy next, especially with something living like a rose or perennial.

A few things about our quality that might help you feel more confident:

How our plants are grown
All our roses are own-root, grown in 1-gallon containers with soil, not bare root grafted stock. This makes them longer-lived and more resilient over time.
They are true to variety and virus-free, grown at our nurseries in Oregon.
We defoliate before shipping so they arrive hydrated and ready to push new growth, not stressed by transit.
How they arrive
Roses ship in a container (plastic or compostable, depending on the product) with established root systems, not tiny “starter” plugs.
Non-rose perennials ship in plastic containers and bulbs in burlap bags (or pre-potted in spring).
Every rose includes a waterproof name tag for easy ID.
Guarantees
Roses: 1-year guarantee.
Perennials: 90-day guarantee.
Bulbs: covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

I want to match you with something that will actually do well for you, not just look nice on the website. Can you share a bit more so I can be really specific?
